name: com.coffeebean.build
description: Native export customization for CoffeeBean: post-process Android Studio (Gradle) & iOS (Xcode) project exports — AndroidManifest / gradle / gradle.properties / libs / res / env injection for Android; Info.plist / frameworks & libs / Build Settings / capabilities / file targets for iOS. Pure-C# injectors (EditMode testable) + thin Unity callback adapters; idempotent; dry-run; config via ScriptableObject/JSON/code steps.

samples.description: 原生导出定制示例：最小配置资产 + fake 导出目录 dry-run 演练（AndroidManifest 权限 / gradle 依赖 / plist 权限文案 / framework 计划）。
